new_public_evidence.source: Wang & Ramdas, Anytime-valid t-tests and confidence sequences for Gaussian means with unknown variance
new_public_evidence.result: The shifted scale-invariant Gaussian t-test martingale has an exact nuisance-scale-free form. This supports reducing the r84 fixed-block factor's power distribution to standardized mean separation plus an independent chi-square SSE.

Finite-sample likelihood-ratio inference against composite/profile nulls and sequential extension support a stronger frozen-confidence-set construction: proper predictive numerator divided by the null likelihood supremum is a conditional e-value whenever the frozen reference confidence set contains the true null parameter.

derived_results.claim: For the moderate Gaussian KL>=1 branch r in [0.065,3.4], the worst reference-good standardized separation for the r84 CI-inf t factor is exactly reduced to theta*=0.3694057 at KL=1,r=3.4. The old r82 proof combined the minimum raw mean shift at r=0.065 with the maximum variance at r=3.4 and was therefore substantially too conservative.

Using the exact standardized block law and a Chernoff bound on cumulative log CI-inf-t evidence gives deterministic-numerical sufficient 95% raw delays of 544 at start, 768 after 1000, 896 after 10000, and 1120 after 1e6 while retaining the old 0.25 mean-direction weight. The matched old r82 formal bounds were 1152,1656 and 2400 at start/1k/1e6. Quadrature is high-order and stable but not directed-rounding certified.

For any proper frozen reference-measurable block predictive density q_R and frozen Gaussian null confidence set C_R, E=q_R/sup_{theta in C_R}p_theta is a conditional e-value on the reference-good event. The current delayed-start heavy-tail mixture remains exactly O(1) because the same current-block multiplier is shared by all candidate starts.

A scale/location-equivariant Normal-Inverse-Gamma predictor with m0=Xbar_R,kappa0=3,alpha0=3,beta0=2*s_R^2, used as one universal factor at weight 0.50 while retaining the two specialized variance factors at 0.25 each, is a strong new candidate. Discovery tuning was separated from deterministic quadrature validation. Dense exact-KL=1/reference-good scans retained about 12 nat/block worst expected log growth. Differential-evolution plus quadrature Chernoff stress gave sufficient 95% raw delays 96/128/128/160 for prechange 0/1k/10k/1e6 respectively. These power numbers are not yet continuum/interval-certified.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The universal-envelope conditional type-I proof is exact, but its current power evidence uses deterministic quadrature/global numerical search rather than a machine-certified continuum maximum.
The NIG hyperparameters were selected on discovery evidence and are not claimed minimax optimal.

Do not delete the specialized variance channels: the existing variance-down/up factors can be much faster on pure variance changes. The current candidate is 0.25 variance-up / 0.25 variance-down / 0.50 universal.
The r85 CI-inf-t Chernoff power constants are deterministic numerical values, not directed-rounding enclosures.
All results are confined to clean iid Gaussian reference plus one fixed iid Gaussian step alternative. No heavy-tail, dependence, gradual drift or repeated-change generalization is supported.
Exact-KL=1 power scans do not yet prove the same or better miss bound for every KL>1 alternative under the universal predictor.

candidate_new.mechanism: Retain the r82 exact variance-up and variance-down block likelihood e-factors. Replace the two conservative mean channels by one frozen-confidence-set universal block factor q_NIG/sup_C p with portfolio weights {0.25,0.25,0.50}. The factor is direction-free, conditionally e-valid on the same reference-good event, and preserves the O(1) telescoping delayed-start recursion.
candidate_new.status: exact conditional type-I/common-increment proof closed; strong exact-KL=1 deterministic-numerical power evidence; continuum KL>=1 power certification and matched detector comparison pending

frontier: Analytically reduce the reference-good envelope for the universal factor. Numerical search consistently places the weakest Chernoff surface at the widest/high-side variance confidence state and mean-reference error toward the alternative; prove or refute these monotonicities.

Continuum-certify the exact Gaussian KL=1 Chernoff miss surface for the frozen NIG hybrid, using interval arithmetic or discovery/independent-validation plus KL transport. Then prove radial monotonicity for KL>=1 or cover an outer shell with an analytic high-information handoff.

Run matched common-random full-detector comparisons between r82 four-direction, r84 CI-inf-t and r85 hybrid at identical unconditional PFA=0.05 for immediate,1k,10k,100k,1e6 changepoints and pure variance endpoints. Do not retune on the validation stream.

Only after continuum certification, investigate RIPr/numeraire or a less conservative predictive numerator; current conditional-null quadrature E[E_UI]<=about 0.401 suggests headroom but does not justify churn before proof.
Replace Gaussian/chi-square quadrature decimals with directed-rounding interval enclosures if available; otherwise keep symbolic formulas authoritative.
exact_next_action: Freeze the r85 NIG predictor and {0.25,0.25,0.50} hybrid weights. Prove monotonicity or derive safe endpoint reductions in reference mean error and reference variance statistic, then certify the exact-KL=1 Chernoff miss surface over Gaussian variance ratio. In parallel run one independent common-random detector comparison against r82/r84, including pure variance endpoints and late changes. Promote the universal factor only if the continuum power certificate and matched validation both survive; otherwise retain the r84 CI-inf-t improvement.
